title: C22 HUBBLE GALACTIC EXHALE engineering data contract
description: Proposed record contract. No data have been collected by this generator. Null is missing/unknown and must be qualified in the separate provenance record.

galaxy_id.description: IFU target and survey selection identity.

spectral_cube.x-quality-rule: Masks/LSF/PSF attached; missing spaxels not interpolated as data.

cube_cov.x-dimension: row/column ordering and dimensions frozen in ICD
cube_cov.x-quality-rule: Shared continuum and spatial covariance retained.

environment.x-encoding: measurement value encoded directly; qualifier, uncertainty, calibration and model version are in the provenance sidecar.

host_covariates.x-encoding: measurement value encoded directly; qualifier, uncertainty, calibration and model version are in the provenance sidecar.
host_covariates.x-unit: solar mass, solar mass yr^-1, degree
host_covariates.x-quality-rule: Joint covariance and source method retained.

wind_probability.x-quality-rule: Bounded zero to one; not a secure physical label.

velocity_proxy.x-encoding: measurement value encoded directly; qualifier, uncertainty, calibration and model version are in the provenance sidecar.

mass_loading.x-encoding: posterior record: representation is explicit; weights and sample dimensions require domain validation.
mass_loading.x-quality-rule: Null when necessary geometry/density inputs unavailable.

x-unit-policy: Use documented units; do not replace missing values with zero. Reference frames, covariance basis, calibration version and quality qualifiers reside in the provenance sidecar.
x-domain-validation: Physical range, covariance validity and declared quality rules require domain validation beyond JSON Schema.
